property_checked.conflicts: every typed conflict is justified by a write in (base_generation, observed_generation] or by a create finding the key taken at the base generation
property_checked.handles: one handle's observed generation never decreases within a domain
property_checked.multi_key: per-domain prefix consistency: reads at generation g see exactly the commits up to g, never half a transaction
property_checked.per_key: register linearizability against the store's publication order: a read at generation g returns the latest write with generation <= g

scope.checked: MW2 disjoint and conflicting writers, multi-key reads, process kills with idempotent retries, MW3 two-domain histories, six deliberately violating fixtures, two accepted controls
scope.label: one host, one local POSIX namespace; synthetic workloads generated by the shipped driver
scope.not_checked: cross-domain serializability (not a promised property), fault injection through the S3 proxy (see the T025 receipt), Go parity
